skill.summary: Improves retention with recall prompts, spaced review, teaching checks, and personal retrieval cues.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Reading Retention Booster.

- Helps users remember reading material using recall prompts, spaced reviews, and teach-back/application checks.
- Offers a step-by-step workflow: clarifies goals, converts notes to recall questions, and creates a review plan.
- Outputs include recall questions, review schedules, teach-back prompts, retrieval cues, and progress checks.
- Designed for personal learning support; avoids academic grading and formal assessments.
- Works with user-supplied reading material, notes, goals, and schedules.
